chunks: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High

key_terms.سَبِّحِ: To glorify or declare free from imperfection

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High'?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is frequently linked to Imam Ali (AS) and is recited during the Fajr prayer, highlighting the connection between divine transcendence and spiritual elevation. It serves as a reminder of God's purity above any imperfection, encouraging believers to purify their souls through consistent remembrance.
